decisions.reason: The safety shoe line builds directly on the firm's core in-house footwear knowledge, and it was upgraded to its own page in 2024, which signals growing commitment.
The comfort insole sits close to the firm's foot-measurement and insole know-how, but it stayed only mentioned and may be merged into the flagship insole range.
The supportive insole uses related ergonomic knowledge and complements the shoe ranges, though its low visibility leaves some risk that it gets folded into the FIT insole system.
The ergonomic safety shoe series had its own page in both years and draws on the firm's established development and production competencies.
The firefighter boots extend existing protective footwear expertise into a specialist segment, and they gained a dedicated page in 2024.

The flagship moulded insole combines the firm's foot-measurement tools, insole knowledge and service capabilities, and the ALBA Braunschweig FIT-DAY shows an early reference customer the firm can learn from.
